units: <cite ref="Eruvin 28b:5">Erub. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ נמי מארעא קא רבי וכ׳</he> cuscuta, too, draws its nourishment from the ground, for behold, as soon as you cut the shrub, the cuscuta on it dies.
<cite ref="Shabbat 107b:12">Sabb. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דתלש כ׳ וכ׳</he> he who tears c. loose from the shrubs &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:18">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ בכרמא עירבובא</he> cuscuta in a vineyard is a forbidden mixture (v. <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 109b:11">Ib. 109ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אוכליה כ׳ וכ׳</he> ordered him to eat c. with salt and to run &c.
